tasks.ColumnCalculation: Calculate the column based on the remainder of the first number divided by 4.
tasks.RowCalculation: Calculate the row based on the remainder of the second number divided by 5.
tasks.SpinWheel1: Determine the first number by spinning the wheel once.
tasks.SpinWheel2: Determine the second number by spinning the wheel a second time.
tasks.SquareLocation: Find the intersection of the calculated column and row to determine the square location on the checkerboard.
